visible_condition: appears brand new in stock photo
hidden_risks: Stock photo used does not show the actual physical condition or wear and tear of the item being sold
Mechanical wear of the resistance system, pedals, and chain or belt drive
Condition of the saddle, handlebars, and electronic display functionality
response.best_proof: A clear, untampered photo of the actual spinning bike showing its current condition, including pedals, seat, and console.
seller_claims_unsupported: Actual physical condition and durability of the specific unit being sold
response.drop_reason: The seller is using a stock or catalogue photo instead of a photo of the actual item.
response.failure_mode: AI might value the item as brand new based on the pristine stock photo, missing wear and tear or misrepresenting the actual item.
